title: Add RAG Guided Bootstrapping Wizard and typed stub generator (stubgen)
author: Ayesha Kapoor
release_notes: Introduces a guided bootstrapping quickstart that scaffolds RAG projects, generates typed tool stubs, and wires basic telemetry and smoke tests.
description: Motivation: onboarding teams to RAG workflows is still manual and time consuming; this quickstart introduces a guided bootstrapping wizard that scaffolds a minimal RAG app, generates typed tool contract stubs (TypeScript/Go), wires a basic telemetry mapping, and includes a smoke harness to validate local runs. What this PR does: adds a new quickstart 'rag-boot-wizard' with an interactive CLI wizard (node), a small stub generator (stubgen) that emits typed tool bindings + sample connectors, documentation with stepwise screenshots and expected outputs, CI smoke job to run the scaffold and ensure the example boots, and a compact example app wired to the Redwood hosted API for local dev. Key files: quickstarts/rag-boot-wizard/README.md, quickstarts/rag-boot-wizard/wizard.ts, quickstarts/rag-boot-wizard/stubgen/index.ts, templates/stubgen/tool_stub.tmpl, examples/rag-miniserver/*, docs/snippets/boot-wizard-usage.md, ci/smoke/wizard-smoke.yml. Checklist: - [x] CLI flow and prompts implemented - [x] stubgen emits TypeScript and Go typed tool interfaces - [x] telemetry mapping example included and documented - [x] smoke CI runs complete in CI container - [x] docs and quickstart README expanded with troubleshooting notes Local testing: run `yarn workspace quickstarts run boot-wizard` to start an interactive session; `yarn workspace quickstarts run stubgen -- --lang ts --out examples/rag-miniserver/src/stubs` to generate stubs; `make smoke` in examples/rag-miniserver to run the lightweight smoke harness. Backwards compatibility notes: this is additive only and lives under quickstarts; it does not change existing templates. Related: ENG-1189 covers onboarding flows; PM-404 is the product request for guided templates. Merge strategy: squash merge after approvals and CI green.
